title: polynomial_fit
goal: Complete source series before polynomial forecasting
guidance: Collect every fitting month and the independent actual target before forecasting. Polynomial Program binds cells and explicit x coordinates, fits with intercept and submits predict/absolute_error. Never fit to the target month.

title: difference_value
guidance: Bind from_source and to_source from matching definitions and units; choose signed to-minus-from or absolute literally. Difference Program reads the cells, subtracts and submits with the requested numeric precision.

title: rolling_range
goal: Rolling statistic over the full requested scope
guidance: Bind observations in chronological order; group separate years so windows do not cross boundaries. rolling_mean_range computes each group's windows, then one max-minus-min across all windows. Return one range, not min-to-max prose.

title: normalized_midpoint
guidance: Use midpoint Program with first/second source cells: abs(b-a)/((abs(a)+abs(b))/2). Keep decimal scale. Set final decimals; submit_answer=true ends the task without another rewrite.

title: compound_growth
goal: Source-bound compound growth and final percent display
guidance: Use CAGR Program with matching base/end source cells and elapsed intervals, not row count. Percent request: output_percent=true, format percent/as_is. It computes, formats and submits once.

title: annual_log
guidance: Continuous annual growth is ln(end/start)/elapsed intervals. Bind matching endpoints to annual-log Program. Set output_percent only for a percent request; otherwise decimal. Choose final display before invoking.

title: absolute_deviation
when: mean of the absolute differences|mean absolute deviation|average absolute deviation
goal: Absolute deviation from the stated benchmark
guidance: Bind every requested period's source cell. Deviation Program computes mean(abs(value-benchmark)); benchmark is the public question value. Percentage-point magnitude stays unchanged; number format adds no unit words.

title: dispersion
goal: Select the statistical population before calculation
guidance: For dispersion of the complete stated years, use population n; use n-1 for an explicitly requested sample estimate. Bind only those years to source cells. Call statistics Program with the selected convention and final format.

title: regression_coordinates
goal: Source-bound linear fit and signed forecast error
guidance: Bind fitting years only; x follows the stated year origin. Put forecast_x and actual_source outside fitting rows. Select forecast_minus_actual or its reverse literally. Call statistics Program to submit the requested scalar.

title: paired_series
guidance: For correlation, pair both acquired series by the same month/year and adjustment basis. Never fill a missing external series from memory. Supply source and x_source per period to statistics Program, then submit once.

title: series_scope
goal: Mean over exactly the requested periods
guidance: List requested periods, then bind one acquired source cell per period. Exclude adjacent totals, forecast dates and duplicates. Call statistics Program with mean/geometric_mean and the final display.

title: series_transform
when: trimmed mean|dev[i]?ation from the median|Theil index
guidance: Bind the complete source series to statistics Program: log_trimmed_mean logs then sorts/trims per tail; median_absolute_deviation_mean averages distances from median; theil_t uses mean((x/mean)*ln(x/mean)).

title: revision_basis
goal: Choose the matching revision before binding cells
guidance: Compare overlapping supplied publications before binding values. If the question fixes an as-of release, use it; otherwise prefer the later retrospective value with the same definition. Distinguish revisions from changed categories.

title: total_scope
guidance: For a requested total, inspect existing continued panels and the total column before selecting a component. Currency of measurement is not a currency-denominated asset subset. Preserve the full category path when binding cells.

title: table_groups
guidance: Keep blanks and year/category headers. Select header, row and column (all cells count from 0). Repeated month rows need full row_text and their group's row_column. Program checks the cell; verify its year/category yourself.

title: final_display
goal: Submit an already computed scalar without rewriting
guidance: When the complete answer is an acquired numeric result, call final_scalar with its result_id/path and explicit display. Percent symbol uses percent; quantity already in requested units uses number. No recalculation or prose afterward.
